question: Stage 0 (S7#12) is 'enemy', but by the end of the episode Nathaniel has left Garrett to die, Garrett agrees to help, and he teleports Yo-Yo, May and Coulson out of the Lighthouse (Yo-Yo and May had refused to unlock him) before Victoria Hand shoots him. Keep 'enemy', or change it to 'ally' and add the turn to the text?
options: Keep enemy (he only helps under duress and dies minutes later)
Change to ally and add: 'Betrayed by Nathaniel, Garrett agrees to teleport Yo-Yo, May and Coulson out, and is shot dead on arrival.'
evidence: The End Is at Hand (S7 ep 12)

question: Stage 2 (S5#20) and other Talbot stages in this chunk (with Daisy, Hale and Robin) call him 'Graviton'. Fandom cites only a Marvel.com interview for that codename, and I could not confirm that it is said on screen. Keep 'Graviton', or use plain wording such as 'after absorbing the Gravitonium'?
evidence: Talbot's codename field on Fandom is sourced to a Marvel.com interview, not an episode

question: Stage 0 (Spider-Man: No Way Home): Cleary questioning Happy with Matt Murdock at his side happens only in the extended 'The More Fun Stuff Version', not in the theatrical cut. Does that re-release count as on screen?
options: Keep: the More Fun Stuff Version was shown in theaters, so it counts as on screen
Treat it like a deleted scene: drop or rewrite this pair, since in the theatrical cut Damage Control only investigates and arrests Happy, with no scene shown between him and Cleary
evidence: Fandom cites the Cleary-Happy-Murdock interrogation only to 'Spider-Man: No Way Home - The More Fun Stuff Version' (ref SMNWHTMFSV). Theatrical-cut refs (SMNWH) cover only the news report that Happy is under investigation, Murdock saying so, and Damage Control agents arresting Happy.

question: Stage 2 (Spider-Man (1967)#40) is kind 'enemy', but the Lizard never appears in it: Spider-Man rescues Dr. Connors from an intelligent alligator. Keep 'enemy' for the pair throughout, or mark the rescue stages as 'ally'?
options: Keep enemy (the pair is Spider-Man vs the Lizard)
Change stage 2 (and stage 1, #18, also a rescue) to ally
evidence: Ep 40b 'Conner's Reptiles': an alligator made intelligent by Connors's experiments kidnaps him, and Spider-Man defeats it. Ep 18a: Spider-Man finds Connors held prisoner at the Spanish fort and frees him. Neither has the Lizard.
